Software Engineer

IBM

IBM is looking for a Software Engineer to join the hybrid cloud organisation in Ottawa. You will build and operate distributed services used by enterprise customers.

What you will do

  • Design and ship backend services in Java or Go
  • Work with product managers to scope and deliver features
  • Improve observability, reliability and deployment automation

Required skills

  • Three or more years of professional software engineering experience
  • Solid understanding of REST API design and relational databases
  • Familiarity with containers and CI pipelines
Recommended jobs: Data Analyst, Product Designer, QA Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer
